_comment: Qwen2-VL vision tower. `params` field name = the bound name the DSL / weights.json reference; `from` paths index the VERBATIM HF config.json's nested `vision_config` block (the configs here carry it byte-for-byte). Tower geometry uses the Qwen2-VL key spellings (`embed_dim` / `depth` / `num_heads` / `in_chans`); MLP width is a ratio (an integer in every shipped Qwen2-VL config), so `vision_mlp_hidden = embed * ratio`. ORDER MATTERS: `expr` entries read bounds that earlier entries defined. Qwen2-VL vision blocks hardcode 1e-6 in the modeling code (transformers / mlx-vlm) and the macro default is 1e-6 too — `vision_norm_eps` is stated here for the record, and the per-checkpoint flat override still wins.
